identite.quote: account details (information about you, like your name, username, email address, birthday, and phone number)
identite.purpose: Gestion du compte et personnalisation de l'expérience utilisateur
identite.purpose_quote: we process your information to provide you a more personalized experience, including to show you content and information that is most relevant to your experience

contact.quote: email address, birthday, and phone number
contact.purpose: Gestion du compte, communication et personnalisation

compte_auth.quote: account details (information about you, like your name, username, email address, birthday, and phone number)

paiement.quote: payment and related information (like your physical address, so we can ship the product to you, payment information, so we can process the payment, and transaction history)
paiement.purpose: Traitement des paiements et livraison des produits

localisation.quote: precise location information (precise location through methods like GPS signals), IP address-based location information (IP address)
localisation.purpose: Personnalisation de l'expérience et recommandations géolocalisées

appareil_technique.quote: device information (such as your device hardware or software, operating system, device memory, advertising identifiers, apps installed, browser type, information from device sensors that measure the motion of your device or compasses and microphones, including whether you have headphones connected, and information about your wireless and mobile connections), information collected by cookies and similar technologies, (cookies, pixels (small graphic data that recognize user activity, such as if and how often a user has visited a website), web storage, unique advertising identifiers), and log information (such as details about how you’ve used our Services, access times, pages viewed, IP address, and unique identifiers like cookies)
appareil_technique.purpose: Fonctionnement des services, personnalisation et sécurité

usage_comportement.quote: usage information (information about how you interact with our Services — for example, which Lenses you view and apply, your premium subscriptions, Stories you watch, and how often you interact with other Snapchatters) and content information (information about content you create or provide, your engagement with the camera and creative tools, your interactions with My AI, and metadata — for example, information about the content itself like the date and time it was posted and who viewed it)
usage_comportement.purpose: Personnalisation de l'expérience et amélioration des services
usage_comportement.purpose_quote: we use information about you across different areas of the Services in order to add context to your Snapchat experience

contenus_utilisateur.quote: content and information about that content, and content you share and generate with our AI Features (content, or “Inputs,” including text, images, video, audio, precise location, and engagement, including content you share with My AI, used to generate content and responses, or “Outputs,”)
contenus_utilisateur.purpose: Stockage et partage de contenu utilisateur

communications.quote: private content and communications (like Snaps and Chats with your friends, voice and video calls, and content that is saved in My Eyes Only)

contacts_reseau.purpose: Faciliter la mise en relation avec les contacts

donnees_tiers.quote: data from advertisers (information from advertisers, app developers, publishers, and other third parties to help target or measure the performance of ads), linked third-party service data (information we get when you link your Snapchat account to another service), contact info from other Snapchatters or third parties
donnees_tiers.purpose: Ciblage publicitaire et amélioration des services

donnees_sensibles.quote: We do not use the private content and communications you send to people who are your friends to personalize your experience, make recommendations, or show you ads

mineurs.quote: Our Services are not directed to children under the age of 13, and you must confirm that you are 13 years or older in order to create an account and use our Services
mineurs.purpose: Protection des mineurs et conformité légale

legal_bases.data: account details (name, username, email address, birthday, phone number)
legal_bases.quote: Many of our Services require you to set up an account. To do this, we ask you to provide us with account details (information about you, like your name, username, email address, birthday, and phone number)

If you use our commerce products to buy something, like those latest sneakers, we may ask you for payment and related information (like your physical address, so we can ship the product to you, payment information, so we can process the payment, and transaction history)

legal_bases.data: device phonebook, camera, photos, microphone, precise location
legal_bases.quote: If you’ve explicitly granted device-level permissions, device information may also include information about your device phonebook (contacts and related information), images and other information from your device’s camera, photos, and microphone (like the ability to take photos, videos, view stored photos and videos, and access the microphone to record audio while recording video), and location information (precise location through methods like GPS signals)

legal_bases.data: usage information, content information, device information, cookies, log information
legal_bases.quote: When you use our Services, we collect information about which of those Services you’ve used and how you’ve used them. This helps us better understand the way our community uses our Services so that we can make improvements

legal_bases.data: private content and communications (for safety and security)
legal_bases.quote: We use your information to enhance the safety and security of our Services, verify Snapchatter identity, and prevent fraud or other unauthorized or illegal activity

We use the data we collect to enforce our Terms and the law. This includes enforcing, investigating, and reporting conduct that violates our Terms, policies, or the law, responding to requests from law enforcement, and complying with legal requirements
Additionally, there may be instances when you interact with our Services that we will ask your permission to collect additional information

countries.name: United States

transfers.quote: we may collect your personal information from, transfer it to, and store and process it in the United States or other countries outside of where you live

recipients.name: Service Providers
recipients.quote: We share your information with our service providers, who process that information on our behalf. For example, we rely on such Service Providers to facilitate payments, measure and optimize the performance of ads, or protect the services

recipients.name: Business and Integrated Partners
recipients.quote: We share your information with business and integrated partners in order to provide the Services. For example, you can use OpenTable within Snapchat to reserve a table

recipients.name: Anti-Fraud Partners
recipients.quote: We share your information, such as device and usage information, with industry partners working to prevent fraud

recipients.name: Legal, Safety, and Security Partners
recipients.quote: We share your information as necessary for the following legal, safety, and security reasons: comply with any valid legal process, governmental request, or applicable law, rule, or regulation

recipients.name: Affiliates
recipients.quote: We may share your information within those internal subsidiaries at your direction, the direction of other users, or as needed to carry out our own and our affiliates’ Services

recipients.name: pixels
recipients.quote: information collected by cookies and similar technologies, depending on your settings, (cookies, pixels (small graphic data that recognize user activity, such as if and how often a user has visited a website), web storage, unique advertising identifiers)

signals.quote: Our Services are not directed to children under the age of 13, and you must confirm that you are 13 years or older in order to create an account and use our Services

we may share some of your information with your friends on Snapchat or other Snapchatters... the content you post to Stories, your current or recent activity status, or your status as a premium subscriber, can be viewed by your Friends if you allow it
